subject: ext-ft
title: EXT.FT.------C.CONT.
description: Second diagram on page 110 (ALT(FT)II-4). The crossing diagrams how extended-functionalism structurally meets composite-continuance at the projectional-strain scale: EXT-FT (extended functionalism) crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance). EXT-FT sits at left; C-CONT at upper-right as partner-axis. AFI-2 (affinity insight, level 2) upper-left, DYM-SPT (dynamic spirituality) upper-center, F (form) upper-center as the upper bridging chain. TECH-DY (technological dynamics) right. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) lower-left, RT-ALGN (reality alignment) center, MTH (method) lower-center-right as bridging chain. INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) at bottom. Structural argument: when extended-functionalism is crossed with composite-continuance, the upper chain AFI-2 -> DYM-SPT -> F -> C-CONT is the bridging route through which affinity-insight level-two reaches composite-continuance via dynamic-spirituality and form. The form's actual continuance reaches the partner through TECH-DY on the right. The lower chain VT-DY -> RT-ALGN -> MTH carries vibrational-dynamics through reality-alignment into method, the subject's downward output.
